title: PRKCA and ABCB1 dual-enriched exosomes are key drivers of drug resistance in chronic myeloid leukemia.
authors: Li, Fei; Lin, Jin-Fei; Tian, Peng; Chen, Haisheng; Yang, Qian; Guo, Qiqi; Wang, Jiasheng; He, Yue; Chen, Junru; Hu, Xiaojian; Li, Chunmou; Mai, Weitong; Duan, Menghan; Peng, Michael; Rousseau, Zackary; Chen, Chun; Ni, Heyu; Zhang, Qing
journal: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究慢性髓系白血病耐药中外泌体传递PRKCA和ABCB1的机制，虽含分子对接但核心是肿瘤耐药信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: Drug resistance frequently results in treatment failure for leukemia and leads to the progression of chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) into an accelerated or blast phase. An increasing number of CML cases exhibit reduced responsiveness or are refractory to tyrosine kinase inhibitors and chemotherapeutic drugs. Exosomes, as intercellular communication carriers, have been shown to participate in various forms of tumor drug resistance, but their role and mechanisms in CML drug resistance have not yet been fully investigated. METHODS: Exosomes were isolated from the cell culture medium or plasma using ultracentrifugation. RNA sequencing, LC-MS proteomics, Western blot, molecular docking, co-immunoprecipitation, cell viability assay, and flow cytometry analysis were carried out to examine the mechanisms of exosomes in CML drug resistance. Cell line-derived and patient-derived xenografts were estimated to verify the mechanisms of exosomes in CML drug resistance in vivo. Clinical samples from CML patients were used to analyze the predictive potential of exosomes in CML drug resistance. RESULTS: Drug-resistant CML cell-derived exosomes promote multifaceted resistance to imatinib and doxorubicin by directly disseminating the ATP-binding cassette subfamily B member 1 (ABCB1) efflux pump to initially sensitive cells and indirectly upregulating ABCB1 expression, enhancing drug expulsion and resistance. The specific binding regions between ABCB1 with protein kinase C-alpha (PRKCA) that is required for dual-enriched exosomal packaging and ABCB1-mediated resistance. We identified myristoylated alanine-rich C kinase substrate (MARCKS) regulation of PRKCA is an essential prerequisite to PRKCA-ABCB1 interaction, forming a tri-protein complex in drug-resistant CML cells that selectively enriches PRKCA and ABCB1 into exosomes. Mechanistically, exosomes enriched with both PRKCA and ABCB1 enhance fatty acid metabolism through PRKCA, activate the AGE-RAGE signaling pathway, and subsequently upregulate the transcription factors ETS1 and FOXA1. This process leads to increased expression of PRKCA and ABCB1 in drug-sensitive cells, which further contribute to drug efflux and drug resistance in CML cells. Clinically, plasma exosomal PRKCA and ABCB1 together accurately predict drug resistance in CML patients. CONCLUSIONS: PRKCA and ABCB1 dual-enriched exosomes are key drivers of drug resistance in CML patients, and exosomal PRKCA and ABCB1 may serve as diagnostic and therapeutic targets for CML.
abstract_zh: 目的：耐药常导致白血病治疗失败，并促使慢性髓性白血病（CML）进展为加速期或急变期。越来越多的CML病例对酪氨酸激酶抑制剂和化疗药物反应降低或难治。外泌体作为细胞间通讯载体，已被证明参与多种形式的肿瘤耐药，但其在CML耐药中的作用及机制尚未被充分研究。方法：采用超速离心法从细胞培养液或血浆中分离外泌体。通过RNA测序、LC-MS蛋白质组学、Western blot、分子对接、免疫共沉淀、细胞活力测定和流式细胞术分析，探讨外泌体在CML耐药中的机制。利用细胞系来源和患者来源的异种移植模型，验证外泌体在CML耐药中的体内机制。使用CML患者的临床样本，分析外泌体在CML耐药中的预测潜力。结果：耐药CML细胞来源的外泌体通过直接向初始敏感细胞传播ATP结合盒亚家族B成员1（ABCB1）外排泵，并间接上调ABCB1表达，增强药物外排和耐药性，从而促进对伊马替尼和阿霉素的多方面耐药。ABCB1与蛋白激酶C-α（PRKCA）之间的特异性结合区域，是双富集外泌体包装和ABCB1介导耐药所必需的。我们鉴定出，肉豆蔻酰化富丙氨酸C激酶底物（MARCKS）对PRKCA的调控是PRKCA-ABCB1相互作用的关键前提，在耐药CML细胞中形成三蛋白复合物，选择性将PRKCA和ABCB1富集到外泌体中。机制上，同时富集PRKCA和ABCB1的外泌体通过PRKCA增强脂肪酸代谢，激活AGE-RAGE信号通路，随后上调转录因子ETS1和FOXA1。这一过程导致药物敏感细胞中PRKCA和ABCB1表达增加，进一步促进CML细胞的药物外排和耐药。临床上，血浆外泌体PRKCA和ABCB1联合可准确预测CML患者的耐药性。结论：PRKCA和ABCB1双富集外泌体是CML患者耐药的关键驱动因素，外泌体PRKCA和ABCB1可能作为CML的诊断和治疗靶点。
